art_direction: 浅烟蓝磨砂玻璃水滴立于乳白台面，底端透明，轮廓简洁。
composition: one original focal subject, centered and readable within a circular avatar crop
creative_direction: Render a single upright droplet sculpture in pale smoky-blue frosted glass. The form is broad at the bottom, with a short gently leaning tip rather than a sharp point. Let the lower edge become slightly clearer, revealing a subtle internal thickness. Place it on a warm off-white tabletop with a light neutral background. Use a large diffused light source and a soft translucent shadow. Keep the object simple, with no bubbles, rainbow caustics, gems, or decorative base competing with its outline. Create a square 1024x1024 avatar with a clear central silhouette that remains legible at thumbnail size. Use an original text-only composition, without lettering, logos, signatures, or watermarks.
style_inspiration: Original artwork from written art direction; prior conversation informs general design preferences, no prior image pixels reused or uploaded.
visual_review: passed: compressed preview inspected for clear original focal composition, requested medium and detail level, circular-crop readability, no unintended anatomy or rendering defects, no text or watermark
